study_type_evidence.quote: BALB/c mice (~20 g) that were fasted for 12 hours were randomly divided into three groups.
The tumor model was established by subcutaneous injection of B16 cells (5×106/mL) into the right armpit of each nude mouse
EA.hy926 cells were seeded in 96-well plates at a density of 5.0×103 cells per well and treated with various concentrations of CS-ES2-AF and ES2-AF

in_vivo_species.quote: BALB/c mice (~20 g) that were fasted for 12 hours were randomly divided into three groups.

in_vivo_species.quote: the nude mice were injected with the FITC-labeled compounds FITC-ES2-AF, FITC-CS-ES2-AF, and CS&FITC-ES2-AF via tail vein

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetic time curves of ES2-AF and CS-ES2-AF in plasma after single intravenous administration. The results are shown as means ± SD (n=5).
concentration_time_figure.note: Figure 7 plots plasma concentration of ES2-AF and CS-ES2-AF against time from 0.5 to 24 h after a single IV dose. Figure 6 additionally shows whole-animal fluorescence images at 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 h, but as imaging panels rather than a plotted concentration-time curve.

bioanalytical_method: Fluorescence spectrophotometry of the FITC label (excitation 280 nm, emission 350 nm) on plasma supernatant with 0.1% SDS added as fluorescent sensitizer; parameters fitted with DAS2.0 software
bioanalytical_quote: the fluorescence intensity of the samples was measured by a fluorescence spectrophotometer (excitation at 280 nm and emission at 350 nm)
notes: Table 1 labels the parameter only as 't1/2' without naming a kinetic phase, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified'. Note that Tmax values of 1.33 h and 1.67 h are reported despite intravenous dosing; recorded exactly as printed and not reinterpreted. Dose is inconsistent between experiments: the PK study used 20 mg/kg IV while the bioimaging study used 25 mg/kg; both are recorded in the relevant quotes. The authors caveat the PK data themselves: 'the fluorescence intensity of FITC represents the concentration of ES2-AF ... but the metabolism of FITC and ES2-AF was not completely synchronized in vivo, and ES2-AF-FITC and free FITC might coexist in mouse plasma'. Methods say mice were 'randomly divided into three groups' but Table 1 reports only two PK arms. The Discussion contains a typographical error stating the ES2-AF molecular weight as 298.12, versus 2,198.12 in the Results; the Results value is recorded. Body-stated component sequences: ES2 = IVRRADRAAVP, AF = GNQWFI.
